summary:
w245 (r219, r220, r222): 2 commits reviewed (b274fa52, 83e3b8ee). No test or feature removed or weakened; no allowances; size clean; one new ruff warning (PLC0206).
Three fix-now findings, all in Merge.taken_back / merge, scripts/supervise_merge.py:
1. A scenario failing in both runs is rerun alone twice (r222 scenario log shows two rerun lines); breaks r219 'once' and can refuse a merge r222 allows.
2. A failing run with an ERROR test is taken back and merged (probe reproduced it).
3. Tests that are not scenarios are rerun and taken back (no line asks for it); for a guarantees work-item the deselected rerun exits 0, so any suite regression is taken back.
Minor: node id cut at ' - ', only -n stripped; duplicate fixture text; file set widened.
questions: Important, scripts/supervise_merge.py:150-151: taken_back runs once for each failing run, so a scenario failing in both runs gets two runs alone (seen in r222's log); r219 says once, and a pass then a fail refuses a merge r222 allows.
Important, scripts/supervise_merge.py:121-125: a failing run with ERROR lines is taken back once its FAILED nodes pass alone, so a branch whose suite errors is merged (probe reproduced it).

Important, scripts/supervise_merge.py:121-122: any FAILED node is rerun, including tests that are not scenarios (no line asks for that); for a work-item all under guarantees capabilities the deselected rerun exits 0, so any suite regression is taken back and merged.
